scope: The B01 named basic RAR candidate and the four-volume classic RAR family referenced by its adjacent test; not an exhaustive audit of all RAR/RAR5 fixtures.
source_numbers: Numbered citations resolve in b01-provenance.md; immutable source identity is the commit/path or Git blob ID, not the mutable GitHub API envelope.
identity_note: Git blob IDs and sizes describe upstream uuencoded files as reported by tree metadata. They are NOT independently calculated decoded archive SHA-256 digests.

missing_definitions.G: Actual archive writer product, exact version/build, generating command/options and a record binding that writer to these immutable bytes; do not use the reader or archive format version.
missing_definitions.P-basic: Creator/source and rights-holder confirmation for the test text, path/link metadata and archive container; a C assertion of expected text is not an authorship statement.
missing_definitions.P-multi: Creator/source and rights for the entire ppmd_lzss_conversion_test.txt, both LibarchiveAddingTest.html copies, testdir/test.txt and path/link metadata; identify the HTML revision and all incorporated material, not just tested tails.
missing_definitions.L: Explicit redistribution terms applicable to these exact encoded archives, decoded containers and all embedded payloads, including attribution/notice requirements and the grantor's authority; distribution-wide COPYING is context, not ignored or treated as prohibition.
missing_definitions.H: After evidence review and authorized acquisition, calculate encoded/decoded SHA-256 and full member hashes and bind them to the provenance record; this audit intentionally does not acquire corpus bytes.
missing_definitions.N: Subsequent B01 native Windows/Linux/macOS operation/error qualification and independent review; no upstream C assertion is a 7-Zip oracle.
